description: This PHP source file defines a class EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator that implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically under the Admin Menu namespace, and is responsible for configuring the menu related to employment status in the admin module.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the employment status screen in the OrangeHRM admin module, overriding the screen as scheduled.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu by overriding the current screen to 'employmentStatus' and returns null.
